cases.name: abort-timeout
cases.html: x

measure.js: run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'slow.txt'); x.send(); x.abort(); log.push('after:' + x.readyState + ':' + x.status); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'slow.txt'); x.send(); setTimeout(() => { x.abort(); log.push('after:' + x.readyState + ':' + x.status); }, 50); })

run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'slow.txt'); x.timeout = 100; x.send(); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'hello.txt'); x.addEventListener('load', () => { x.abort(); log.push('after:' + x.readyState + ':' + x.status); }); x.send(); })

cases.name: reentrancy
cases.html: x

measure.js: run((x, log) => { x.open('POST', 'hello.txt'); x.addEventListener('loadstart', () => { if (!x.a) { x.a=1; x.abort(); log.push('aborted'); } }); x.send('abc'); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('POST', 'hello.txt'); x.addEventListener('readystatechange', () => { if (x.readyState==2) { x.abort(); log.push('aborted'); } }); x.send('abc'); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'hello.txt'); x.addEventListener('load', () => { if (!x.again) { x.again=1; x.open('GET','hello.txt'); x.send(); log.push('resent'); } }); x.send(); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('POST', 'hello.txt'); x.upload.addEventListener('load', () => { x.abort(); log.push('aborted'); }); x.send('abc'); })

run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'hello.txt'); x.addEventListener('progress', () => { log.push('rt:'+x.responseText); x.abort(); log.push('after:'+x.readyState+':'+x.status+':'+x.responseText); }); x.send(); })
run((x, log) => { x.open('GET', 'hello.txt'); x.timeout=100; x.addEventListener('load', () => { x.open('GET','slow.txt'); x.send(); log.push('resent'); }); x.send(); })
